caption: A balloon rubbed on a carpet is rolled near a pile of fine sawdust, and sawdust jumps onto the balloon.

sa.check: A balloon is rubbed on a carpet.
The balloon is rolled near the pile.
The sawdust is fine, like powder or small flakes.
The rub comes first, then the roll near, then the jump.

pc.expect: The sawdust lies still until the balloon is close, then leaps only from the part of the pile near the balloon; the rest of the pile stays put and the leaping stops when the balloon is taken away.
pc.fail: Sawdust leaps before the balloon is brought near; or the whole pile stirs at once; or dust rises from parts of the pile far from the balloon; or dust keeps leaping after the balloon is well away.

pc.expect: The dust that lifts coats the side of the balloon facing the pile and stays on as the balloon is lifted; any that comes loose falls back to the pile.
pc.fail: Dust hovers in the air around the balloon without touching it; or the dust falls off the balloon as soon as it is lifted; or loose dust drifts upward; or the whole pile rises from the floor.

pc.expect: The balloon is a light elastic shell that keeps its round shape; the sawdust is loose fine particles that lift as separate specks.
pc.fail: The balloon keeps a deep dent after the hand leaves; or stretches out like taffy; or the sawdust lifts as a solid slab; or the dust flows up like liquid.

pc.expect: The balloon rolls along the carpet as a ball; the dust moves from the pile to the balloon's near side and stops there.
pc.fail: The balloon slides without rolling or rolls uphill by itself; or dust flies past the balloon and off; or dust circles the balloon in the air; or dust moves away from the balloon.

pc.expect: One balloon and one pile; the dust on the balloon came from the pile; the balloon passes through nothing.
pc.fail: Dust multiplies on the balloon; or dust vanishes in mid-air; or the balloon passes into the floor or the pile; or a second balloon appears.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour, the carpet's pattern and the sawdust's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour or size; or the carpet changes pattern; or the sawdust changes colour.
